svg.title: System Canvas · website architecture
svg.desc: Architecture of the System Canvas website itself: React creates SVG elements from editable object properties, the browser renders them, and JSON persistence preserves those properties between sessions.

text.tspan: Runs this website's JavaScript, HTML and CSS
